g.text: Cluster.forecastRegion holds the enum value; this
association carries the forecast text and validity
period the flag was derived from (1.3.4, 1.3.5).
Written only when a work order is Verified (8.3.12).
Feeds the DaysSinceLastTreatment driver, so the next
score must be lower (4.1.17). This closes the loop.
One role per account (2.2.1). The real NEA / town-council
split of task types is a recorded simplification, not an
omission: one Operations Manager, one Cleaning Crew.
The configuration record that generalises the scorer:
score = severityMultiplier x urgency (4.2.4). The mosquito
profile carries severityMultiplier 1.000 and the tier A
weight set, which is what holds every dengue score
A third-party sighting, NOT a resident complaint. Obscured
coordinates and accuracy worse than 500 m are rejected at
ingestion (1.5.6, 1.5.7) and the driver is labelled
290 NEA-registered operators, geocoded from postal code
(1.6.1-1.6.8). These are REGISTERED OFFICES, so the driver
they feed measures response capacity, not demand - which is
why 4.1.25 carries weight 0.05 and no more.
Written when the system declines work it has no authority
to do (8.1.14, 8.6.1). It writes NO TreatmentRecord: the
locality was not treated, and pretending otherwise would
